bio: Communication designer from Mumbai whose graduation project developed a Devanagari-script type design based on Adrian Frutiger's Univers, under the guidance of Mahendra Patel. Has since designed and contributed to several Devanagari typefaces published by the Indian Type Foundry, including the Sanchar Devanagari family.
